description: USGS Earthquakes Database is a data resource listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets under the section "Natural Disasters", published or maintained by the publisher of earthquake.usgs.gov. KML files of all earthquakes recorded by the USGS (across the whole world) from 1973 to present. Available as one dataset or grouped by magnitude or year. Coverage: worldwide or as described in the list entry. The list files it under "Natural Disasters". The entry links to earthquake.usgs.gov. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-free-gis-data-list.
